verdict.rationale: n8n documents a built-in credentials system, with a credentials section and per-integration credential types (Asana, GitHub, Okta and others), so connection secrets are stored centrally in the platform. Role-based access and admin roles are also claimed, which implies some governance over users. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly shows sharing a credential with teammates or setting per-credential permissions. Missing for 10: documented credential sharing with users or teams, per-credential access control (who can use which credential), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
